_COMMA_SAFE = frozenset({"EUR"})

cat >> tests/test_statement.py <<'EOF'


def _parse(text):
    import csv
    import io

    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text)))


def test_usd_payee_with_comma_matches_the_header():
    text = export_statement(
        [Line("chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Smith, Jones LLP", 1250, "retainer", "USD")]
    )
    assert text.splitlines()[1] == 'chk-100,2024-06-02,"Smith, Jones LLP",12.50,retainer'
    assert _parse(text)[1] == ["chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Smith, Jones LLP", "12.50", "retainer"]


def test_eur_comma_is_preserved_not_flattened():
    text = export_statement(
        [Line("eur-1", "2024-06-02", "Müller, Schmidt GmbH", 100, "a,b", "EUR")]
    )
    assert _parse(text)[1] == ["eur-1", "2024-06-02", "Müller, Schmidt GmbH", "1.00", "a,b"]


def test_quotes_and_newlines_are_escaped():
    text = export_statement(
        [Line("chk-100", "2024-06-02", 'The "Best" Co', 100, "line1\nline2", "USD")]
    )
    rows = _parse(text)
    assert len(rows) == 2
    assert rows[1] == ["chk-100", "2024-06-02", 'The "Best" Co', "1.00", "line1\nline2"]
EOF
